claims.text: British Act; Asaf Ali/Lovett report Pakistani arrangements unknown

The British Act appoints 15 August for two dominions. Asaf Ali’s account recorded by Lovett later reports Delhi refugee-relief and resettlement administration. The Indian Assembly minority assurance remains a promise. Neither Indian witness establishes Pakistani arrangements or assent; statutory transition did not itself administer displacement.
Did naming two dominions remove the need for refugee-relief administration? Delhi relief and resettlement required separate reported administrative action
